1	//! Loss-governor manual recovery is a safety check, not an operator override.
2	//! It clears a halt only when the triggering condition has verifiably passed by
3	//! clock: a daily-loss halt clears only after the UTC day rolls, and a
4	//! rolling-loss halt clears only when more than the full rolling window has
5	//! elapsed. Exact equality refuses. The rolling-window authority is the current
6	//! config value, so a reviewed config change is the sanctioned lever; every
7	//! configured limit is still re-checked live by the loss governor at the next
8	//! node start. Per-trade, drawdown, stale-snapshot, and legacy stores without a
9	//! typed trigger reason require runtime-path recovery.
10	//!
11	//! Stop the node before running this command. The kill-switch state file remains
12	//! last-writer-wins, so a live node can rewrite the state after the CLI writes
13	//! it. Manual-recovery audit attempts are stored in a sibling unbounded
14	//! append-only JSONL file, so state races cannot erase the audit trail.
15	//! Operators rotate that audit file externally. The last audit record for a
16	//! given attempt is authoritative: `attempted` is written before the state write,
17	//! followed by `recovered` after a successful state write or `write-failed` when
18	//! the write fails.
19	//!
20	//! Refusals after config and store-path resolution are audited when the audit
21	//! path is appendable. Pre-config failures and an unwritable audit path are the
22	//! non-auditable boundary because no durable audit line can be written there.
23	//!
24	//! `evidence_path` and `evidence_sha256` are operator-attested audit metadata.
25	//! This command never opens the evidence file and never hash-verifies it; the
26	//! values are recorded so reviewers can find and verify the external evidence.

309	pub fn recover_loss_governor_manual_halt(
310	    loaded: &LoadedBoltV3Config,
311	    command: LossGovernorManualRecoveryCommand,
312	) -> Result<LossGovernorManualRecoveryOutcome, LossGovernorManualRecoveryError> {
313	    let kill_switch = loaded
314	        .root
315	        .risk
316	        .kill_switch
317	        .as_ref()
318	        .ok_or(LossGovernorManualRecoveryError::MissingKillSwitchConfig)?;
319	    if !kill_switch.enabled {
320	        return Err(LossGovernorManualRecoveryError::KillSwitchDisabled);
321	    }
322	
323	    let loss_governor = loaded
324	        .root
325	        .risk
326	        .loss_governor
327	        .as_ref()
328	        .ok_or(LossGovernorManualRecoveryError::MissingLossGovernorConfig)?;
329	    if !loss_governor.enabled {
330	        return Err(LossGovernorManualRecoveryError::LossGovernorDisabled);
331	    }
332	
333	    let store = KillSwitchStore::from_root_config_path(&loaded.root_path, kill_switch);
334	    let action_policy = halt_action_policy(loss_governor)?;
335	    let evidence = match LossGovernorManualRecoveryEvidence::new(
336	        command.operator_id.clone(),
337	        command.evidence_path.clone(),
338	        command.evidence_sha256.clone(),
339	        command.observed_at_ns,
340	        action_policy.manual_recovery_evidence_max_path_bytes,
341	    ) {
342	        Ok(evidence) => evidence,
343	        Err(error) => {
344	            record_refused_manual_recovery_command_attempt(
345	                &store,
346	                &command,
347	                command.now_ns,
348	                &format!("invalid manual recovery evidence: {error:?}"),
349	            )?;
350	            return Err(LossGovernorManualRecoveryError::InvalidManualRecoveryEvidence(error));
351	        }
352	    };
353	    if !kill_switch
354	        .authorized_operator_ids
355	        .iter()
356	        .any(|operator_id| operator_id == evidence.operator_id())
357	    {
358	        record_refused_manual_recovery_attempt(
359	            &store,
360	            &evidence,
361	            command.now_ns,
362	            "authorization refused: operator is not authorized by risk.kill_switch.authorized_operator_ids",
363	        )?;
364	        return Err(LossGovernorManualRecoveryError::UnauthorizedOperator {
365	            operator_id: evidence.operator_id().to_string(),
366	        });
367	    }
368	
369	    let record = store
370	        .load_recovery_record()
371	        .map_err(LossGovernorManualRecoveryError::StoreLoad)?;

488	fn persist_manual_recovery_attempt(
489	    store: &impl LossGovernorManualRecoveryStoreWriter,
490	    current_state: &KillSwitchState,
491	    loss_protection: &KillSwitchLossProtectionSnapshot,
492	    manual_recovery: KillSwitchLossGovernorManualRecoveryRecord,
493	) -> Result<usize, LossGovernorManualRecoveryError> {
494	    let write_failed_manual_recovery = manual_recovery.clone();
495	    let recovered_manual_recovery = KillSwitchLossGovernorManualRecoveryRecord {
496	        outcome: Some(KillSwitchLossGovernorManualRecoveryOutcome::Recovered),
497	        outcome_reason: None,
498	        ..manual_recovery.clone()
499	    };
500	    let manual_recovery_count = match store.append_loss_governor_manual_recovery(manual_recovery) {
501	        Ok(count) => count,
502	        Err(recovery_error) => {
503	            if let Some(error) = repair_manual_recovery_audit_error(&recovery_error) {
504	                return Err(error);
505	            }
506	            let failed = failed_manual_intervention_state(
507	                current_state,
508	                format!("loss governor manual recovery audit write failed: {recovery_error:?}"),
509	            );
510	            return match store.write_state_with_loss_snapshot(&failed, Some(loss_protection)) {
511	                Ok(()) => Err(LossGovernorManualRecoveryError::StoreWriteFailed {
512	                    path: store.path().to_path_buf(),
513	                    source: recovery_error,
514	                }),
515	                Err(failed_error) => Err(LossGovernorManualRecoveryError::FailedStateWriteFailed {
516	                    path: store.path().to_path_buf(),
517	                    recovery_error,
518	                    failed_error,
519	                }),
520	            };
521	        }
522	    };
523	    if let Err(recovery_error) =
524	        store.write_state_with_loss_snapshot(&KillSwitchState::Armed, Some(loss_protection))
525	    {
526	        let write_failed = KillSwitchLossGovernorManualRecoveryRecord {
527	            outcome: Some(KillSwitchLossGovernorManualRecoveryOutcome::WriteFailed),
528	            outcome_reason: Some(format!(
529	                "loss governor manual recovery write failed: {recovery_error:?}"
530	            )),
531	            ..write_failed_manual_recovery
532	        };
533	        if let Err(audit_error) = store.append_loss_governor_manual_recovery(write_failed) {
534	            log::error!(
535	                "failed to append write-failed loss-governor manual recovery audit line for {}: {audit_error}",
536	                store.path().display()
537	            );
538	        }
539	        let failed = failed_manual_intervention_state(
540	            current_state,
541	            format!("loss governor manual recovery write failed: {recovery_error:?}"),
542	        );
543	        return match store.write_state_with_loss_snapshot(&failed, Some(loss_protection)) {
544	            Ok(()) => Err(LossGovernorManualRecoveryError::StoreWriteFailed {
545	                path: store.path().to_path_buf(),
546	                source: recovery_error,
547	            }),
548	            Err(failed_error) => Err(LossGovernorManualRecoveryError::FailedStateWriteFailed {
549	                path: store.path().to_path_buf(),
550	                recovery_error,
551	                failed_error,
552	            }),
553	        };
554	    }
555	    match store.append_loss_governor_manual_recovery(recovered_manual_recovery) {
556	        Ok(count) => Ok(count),
557	        Err(audit_error) => {
558	            log::error!(
559	                "failed to append recovered loss-governor manual recovery audit line for {} after Armed state write succeeded: {audit_error}",
560	                store.path().display()
561	            );
562	            Ok(manual_recovery_count)
563	        }
564	    }
565	}

content.text: Core file read. The two-phase `attempted → Armed write → recovered` ordering in `persist_manual_recovery_attempt` is the crux. Let me read the round-4 delta to see exactly what changed vs round-3, then verify the store's torn-audit + atomic-write guarantees.

Now I understand the round-4 fix precisely: round-3 appended a single record labeled **`Recovered`** *before* the Armed write succeeded (over-claiming). Round-4 splits it into `Attempted` (pre-write) → Armed write → `Recovered` (post-write). The two failure-path unit tests now assert `record[0] == Attempted`, which would fail against round-3's `Recovered` labeling. 

Now I need to verify the store's actual guarantees — the `TornManualRecoveryAudit` detection and the atomicity of `write_state_with_loss_snapshot`. Let me read the store and its delta.
